critical_operation.description: param.Path is interpolated into the log format with %s. A decoded newline or carriage return in the request path becomes a real line break in the emitted log, letting a remote client forge additional log lines. The fix switches the verb to %#v, which emits a Go-quoted string.

entry_point.description: The middleware reads c.Request.URL.Path and c.Request.URL.RawQuery, both attacker-controlled.

trace.description: fmt.Fprint(out, formatter(param)) writes the unquoted value to the log writer

verification_method: Static read of logger.go at the exact v1.5.0 commit 15ced05c5316609bce5b43389f8e3f06102a8b18, compared with fix commit a71af9c144f9579f6dbe945341c1df37aaf09c0d and with logger.go at v1.6.0. No code executed.
